description: 楼层共用大叶橡皮树，28 片宽厚弯曲叶片、三株木质茎、奶白陶盆；高 205 厘米，盆径 46 厘米。

foliage.source: Original procedural mesh; broad closed-color blades with curved midribs, secondary veins, petioles and growing tips
foliage.geometry: Actual curved blade surfaces with separately shaded undersides; no alpha-cutout leaf cards
foliage.planter: Retained rounded ivory ceramic planter from part_floor_plant_v002, resized to 46 cm

reuse: One movable assembly, intended for first/second/third-floor placements; current trial replaces only Corner floor plant 6 on floor one.
